tools.name: check_contractor
tools.description: Looks up a contractor's public credential in indexed state and local licensing records. Licenses, registrations and bond records mean different things. Each record carries a credential object (kind, label, note): kind is license, registration, business_license or bond when the source makes that clea

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_contractor · Private data: check_contractor · Public sink: check_contractor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_contractor · Private data: check_contractor · Public sink: check_contractor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "check_contractor" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
